_meta.note: The adapter is the Real Adapter Contract lane's pinned build (test/real_adapters/package.json, npm ci): codex-acp 2.3.0, driven over stdio by a scratch client against a loopback Responses-API model stub, so no real model or credential was involved; the scratch home was a fresh mode-700 directory, never the user's ~/.kiro/crew. The session is a crewmate WORKER: Kiro Crew's own code built both what it ran on. Its session/new array is providers/mirrors/codex.py codex_projection('kirocrew-mate-worker', session_key=<the worker's key>), which read mate_worker.worker_session_spec: a worker base (prompt 'You are the worker.', tools [read], no servers) merged with a crewmate file `pixel` (tools [@pixel-probe], one stdio MCP server whose one tool, probe_codeword, returns kumquat-17, and a prompt telling the worker to call that tool when asked for the release codeword). The array carried exactly one element, `pixel-probe`; the same projection with no session key carried none. The prompt text was the [AGENT SYSTEM PROMPT] block context_assembly.agent_spec._crewmate_worker_prompt built for that worker with codex in ACP_BACKENDS_MATE_WORKER_PROMPT_IN_CONTEXT: the base, the worker principles, then the crewmate's sentence, followed by 'What is the release codeword?'. The stub calls the tool only when the crewmate's sentence is in the request it was sent and the tool is in that request's own tool list, then answers with the function_call_output it got back; both held. After session/new the client sets mode read-only over session/set_config_option (Routing.SESSION_CONFIG) and answers the permission request allow_once. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, with these reductions at capture: the session uuid is a fixed name; the available_commands_update frame is dropped; models.availableModels is emptied and each multi-option select in configOptions keeps only its current value, as codex/session-live.jsonl does. The worker's call reached its crewmate's server: tool_call mcp.pixel-probe.probe_codeword, a session/request_permission marked is_mcp_tool_approval, a completed tool_call_update whose rawOutput is kumquat-17, and a reply of kumquat-17.
